options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the option group. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: dhcp_options
options.description: The list of DHCP options for the option group. May be either a specific option or a group of options.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the option group. Must contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The type of protocol (I(ip4) or I(ip6)).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the option group in JSON format.
